listing.name: Rise of the Concordact Navy
listing.summary: Adds the Concordact, a powerful minor polity with a presence in the northwestern Core Worlds, past League space.
listing.aiSummary: Adds the Concordact faction with modified midline and high-tech ships focused on extended engagements.

description:
"Don the obsidian and white. Preserve the Sector."

Adds the Concordact, a powerful minor polity with a presence in the northwestern Core Worlds, past League space. Distinguished by the monochrome liveries of their fleet of modified midline and high tech ships, Concordact doctrine favours extended engagements, outlasting the enemy before overrunning them when they falter.

The Ships

There may also be a few other things out there to find...good hunting. ;)

Requires MagicLib, LazyLib, GraphicsLib and Nexerelin.

(Not compatible with existing saves! A new save will be required to experience this mod.)

Download: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1bebjnAmR6ycxd-PGeamWAtEFscd6Qc8K/view?usp=sharing

Changelog
0.2.0 (don't ask about 0.1.0)
Initial mod release

Concordact Navy - Emergent Threats

A submod for Rise of the Concordact Navy, adding a few extra ships fielded by the Concordact in their war with the IX Battlegroup. Requires Emergent Threats and IX Revival.

There's also interaction with IX Revival even without this submod! Find Gregory Wakefield and have a chat with him about the major threats of the Sector.

Download: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1an6CmAwLCrFrXyWNWQv9T5GaUwMRDDuf/view?usp=sharing

The Ships

(Credits to Fellout, BinBin and Joebob for letting me use their ships, Tariflette for the Nightjar and (spoiler) sprites, and Vicegrip for letting me use ET and IX assets.)

(No AI has been used in any area of this project! If there is AI content anywhere, I didn't put it there, and please let me know so I can get rid of it.)
